Redo of Healer did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Keyaru, who is exploited by his government, as well as mentally, physically and sexually abused repeatedly by others due to being a healing magician, notices what lays just beyond his healing magic, and is convinced that a healing magician is the strongest class in the world. However, by the time he realizes his own potential, he is already deprived of everything.

The honest version of Redo of Healer starts by giving up the comforting part. Thus, using his healing magic, enhanced by the magic-enhancing properties of the Philosopher's Stone on the world itself, he goes back four years into the past, deciding to redo everything and get revenge on the ones who abused him and take down a corrupted empire. The Healing Hero and the series' main protagonist, who was blessed with the hero's insignia from the coming-of-age.

Strip Redo of Healer of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. He, however, wanted to save the world from demons only to endure four years of physical, mental, and sexual abuse at the hands of his own allies, making him see how corrupted the Jioral Kingdom is. In the midst of the battle with the demon lord, Eve, Keyaru managed to retain himself finding the true nature of his power and obtains the Philosopher's Stone.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Redo of Healer shows exactly where that breaks. Instead of handing it to Flare as instructed, he uses the item to travel back in time, all while being able to maintain his memories of the original timeline, to exact revenge against his torturers and bring down Jioral. His thirst for revenge and mostly psychopathic personality (caused by the torture he endured) makes him a villain protagonist, although he does have a caring side.

What looks like free choice in Redo of Healer is older than choice itself. Flare is the main source of Keyaru's suffering and merely sees him as a baggage carrier and drugs him so he would be receptive to her commands and trains him so that he can be of some use to her. Generally, she saw healing magicians as the lowest class in the magic world until Keyaru has proven otherwise and does not trust her with the Philosopher's Stone.

Nobody designed the part of Redo of Healer you experience — it was inherited. In the alternate timeline, when Flare is left vulnerable, Keyaru tortures and rapes her, takes her powers, erases and alters her memories and appearance to become his companion and lover named Freia, all while deceiving everyone into thinking that Flare is dead. As Freia, she is meek, kind, and obeys Keyarga's every command, including sometimes "acting" as Flare, caring only for him above all else.

Every serious account of Redo of Healer eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. A female demi-human slave that Keyaru buys and recruits into his party. Prior to this, she was infected with an illness (which Keyarga helps to cure), but her rage allows her to withstand it.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Redo of Healer — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Setsuna comes from the Ice Wolf clan whereas estranged from humanity and usually sold into slavery that defeats the purpose of equality in the Jioral Kingdom. As Keyarga offers her the chance to avenge her tribe, she reveals her unspoken true name to receive empowering strength from Keyarga, allowing him to gain control over her.

The selfish-gene reading of Redo of Healer makes it less romantic and far more precise. Setsuna later becomes sexually attached to Keyarga and often competes with Freia for his affections. A female black-winged demon who is one of the candidates to become the Demon Lord.

Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. In the previous timeline where she did become the Demon Lord and fought Keyaru in the bitter end, she tearfully begged him to spare her and granted him the Philosopher's Stone, prompting Keyaru to know what she was really trying to protect. When she completes the trials of Caladrius, her hair changes from black to silver.

The feeling that Redo of Healer means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. After forming cooperation with her newfound empire, Eve and Keyarga develop mutual love for each other and unlike the other girls, they have proper sex. Both sisters had a close relationship until Flare received a higher reputation for awakening as the Magic Hero and belittles Norn.

Nothing in Redo of Healer was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Compared to her big sister, Norn is a strategist who runs her kingdom in a sadistic and manipulative manner and aims to drive Flare out of the throne. In the previous world, Norn saw through Keyaru's scheme and revenge plot but foolishly lets it slide, making him see Norn his greatest foe.

The psychology underneath Redo of Healer is simpler and older than the story on top. Following Flare's apparent murder, Norn meant to gain aid from neighboring kingdoms by exterminating all innocent demons, after her soldiers killed a friend that Keyarga got to know. As he did with Flare, Keyarga rapes her and erases and alters Norn's memories and appearance to become his little sister named Ellen.

Behind Redo of Healer sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. As Ellen, she has a brother complex and views Freia as a "big sister". Kureha owes Keyaru her gratitude for fixing her amputated arm from their first meeting.

The nihilist does not deny Redo of Healer — he only refuses to flatter it. She initially opposes Keyaru's party after believing that they were attacking soldiers who were trying to protect Setsuna's village (not realizing that the soldiers were actually threatening the villagers), but allies with them after learning of her kingdom's atrocities. Freia pretends to be her old self to yield Kureha to her words.

What culture calls destiny in Redo of Healer is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. After being exposed to aphrodisiac and becoming an obedient ally, Keyaru rapes Kureha as punishment for going against him; Kureha does not resist as she has truly developed feelings for him, and also has her act as an informant for him. The bleak reading of Redo of Healer is also the most testable one. When Proum learns of this (although both he and Leonard are unaware that Flare is still alive), he is released and sent to hunt down Keyaru, who by now has changed his name to Keyarga. After Leonard murders Anna, Keyarga takes his revenge on him by turning him into a girl, having him get gang raped by his brainwashed troops, and then burning them alive.

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Redo of Healer.
